An https image URL is extracted into metadata.images when extract_metadata is true

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p><img src=\"https://example.com/photo.jpg\" alt=\"A photo\"></p>", new ConversionOptions { ExtractMetadata = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Images);
```
